meta.description: This is a 10 band Sentinel 2 ARD COG from the UK Earth Observation Data Hub. The data is in CRS for British National Grid (EPSG 27700), which is added as a custom CRS as it is not supported by default. This has been configured as an RGB composite, mapping the bands 3, 2, and 1 respectively to RGB channels, via the bands config on the COG. Three spectral signature chart examples have been configured (for use with Preview -> dev-pixel-charts in the config budiler). The first leaves x-axis config empty, displaying all bands with a simple band number (1, 2, 3 etc). The second example labels X axis values as named S2 bands (B2, B3 etc). Third example, names just the first three bands (Blue, Green, Red), so no more are displayed.
Base layer: Stadia Alidade Smooth Dark
True colour composite of 2021 Sentinel 2 data.

meta.description:
This is a 10 band Sentinel 2 ARD COG from the UK Earth Observation Data Hub.  In this visualisation, the red, green and blue bands are used to create a colour composite that presents the data in natural colour, close to how it would be visualised by eye.

The data is in CRS for British National Grid (EPSG 27700), which is added as a custom CRS.

This is a 10 band Sentinel 2 ARD COG from the UK Earth Observation Data Hub.  In this visualisation, the short wave infrared, near infrared and blue bands are used to create a colour composite that highlights agriculture, separating out crops from bare soil and water.

The data is in CRS for British National Grid (EPSG 27700), which is added as a custom CRS.
